caption: The drawing depicts two gloves, side by side and slightly overlapping, positioned vertically with the fingers pointing downward. Both gloves are outlined in black pencil, with the right glove filled in using a light brown or beige wash, while the left glove is left uncolored except for its outline. On the palm area of the right glove, there is a detailed, circular medallion-like image featuring a portrait of a person and text around the edge, rendered in grey tones. The background of the drawing is an off-white or cream paper, and there are no additional objects or patterns present. The composition is simple, focusing on the gloves and the medallion detail.
title: Gloves
